notes.title: Yurei Hunt Launch Event
notes.content:
[h1]👻 Yurei Hunt is Now in Early Access![/h1]

Yurei Hunt is a Japanese-themed prop hunt game where ghosts hide as everyday objects, and hunters try to find them before time runs out. It's spooky, fun, and full of surprises, and it’s available now in Early Access!

[h2]🕹️ What’s the Game About?[/h2]
👻 Play as a ghost and disguise yourself as props around the map.

🏹 Or play as a hunter and track the ghosts down before time runs out.

🌸 Explore beautiful, stylized maps inspired by Japanese culture and supernatural folklore.


[h2]🚧 Early Access & Roadmap[/h2]
We’re launching in Early Access to build the game with your feedback. The core game is already fun and playable, but we have a lot more planned!


[h2]📜 Our roadmap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516065/db8d2f79abbcdc56c440f4365720d8f0ae4ebe31.png[/img]

[b]💸 Launch Offer – 40% Off![/b]
To celebrate the launch, Yurei Hunt is available at 40% off for a limited time!

It’s the perfect time to jump in and try the game.

[b]💬 Join our community on Discord[/b]

https://discord.gg/BwjF8X485a

Let the hunt begin!
— The 71 Studios Team
